- README.md:2735 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The phrase "the earlier scope-marker guard (`WORKFLOW_HEAL_SCOPE_MARKER_GUARD_ENABLED`) skips the other such reports the same way" is wrong, because the guard lives inside `_open_issue` at scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2764-2775, after diagnosis and classification, and fires only for issue-opening classifications.
  WHY: Label-only reports with `consumer-config`, `transient` or `already-fixed` verdicts leave through scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2984-3027 and never reach the guard, so operators would wrongly think the diagnosis cost is avoided for them.
- README.md:2735 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The clause "Duplicates, escalations, PR comments and no-issue classifications are unaffected." is false with the creation gate on. A run-less `engine_fallback` report exits at scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2282-2285 with `CLASSIFICATION="none"`, making the `already-fixed` (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:3006-3026) and `consumer-config|transient` (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2984-3004) branches unreachable.
  WHY: Operators expect the `consumer-config` ERROR page or the `already-fixed` DEBUG note for an unbound engine_fallback report, and neither is sent now. Only the "no-issue classifications" half of the clause is stale.
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2282-2285
  PROBLEM: The skip exits 0 with only a `WORKFLOW_HEAL skip ...` log line and a step-summary line, so a reader cannot tell that no model call was made.
  WHY: Suggested fix: emit one `::notice::WORKFLOW_HEAL engine_fallback skipped before diagnosis (no bound run; the creation gate is on)` next to the skip (1 line).
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2282
  PROBLEM: The guard is a bare string comparison on `SOURCE_KIND`, so a new kind that names no run would fall through to a full diagnosis.
  WHY: No fix needed: the kind set is closed and validated by `validate-payload`, and a generic predicate would widen scope. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
